commands.text:
if grep -rn "expect(true)\.toBe(true)\|expect(1 + 1)\.toBe(2)\|it('placeholder'" tests/ src/__tests__/ 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "::error::Placeholder tests detected. Replace with real assertions or use it.skip() with a tracking issue."
  exit 1
fi

if [ ! -d "dist" ]; then
  echo "Error: dist directory not created"
  exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "dist/index.js" ]; then
  echo "Error: dist/index.js not found"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Build artifacts present"

commands.step: Install npm >= 11.5.1 (required for OIDC trusted publishing)
commands.text:
# Node 22 ships npm 10.9, which signs provenance but cannot negotiate
# the OIDC auth path (publish PUT returns a misleading 404). Install a
# newer npm into a sandbox prefix and shadow it on PATH — an in-place
# `npm i -g npm@latest` races the bundled arborist and breaks.
npm install --prefix "$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox" npm@latest >/dev/null 2>&1
echo "$HOME/.npm-cli-sandbox/node_modules/.bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

PKG_VERSION="$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
if [ "${{ steps.tag.outputs.version }}" != "$PKG_VERSION" ]; then
  echo "::error::Tag ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }} does not match package.json version $PKG_VERSION"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Tag ${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }} matches package.json version $PKG_VERSION"

commands.step: Publish to npm (OIDC trusted publishing + provenance)

commands.text:
TAG="${{ steps.tag.outputs.tag }}"
if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "Release $TAG already exists — skipping."
else
  gh release create "$TAG" --title "$TAG" --generate-notes
fi
